title: Finite-window dependence of real-SWAP storage sensitivity versus MODFLOW storage ownership

selection.reason: same qbot=1e-6 cm/day and READY head response, while window_day spans 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2
excluded: B5 because qbot differs and no symmetric derivative plateau

fixed_modflow_fixture.note: These are F-GC45 numerical-fixture storage parameters. No claim of physical equivalence to the SWAP column is made a priori.

calculations: For each selected baseline record dt, u_A, J_S, J_R and u_A/dt.
Compute u_A/Sy only as a scale ratio, not as a storage-partition claim.
Compute successive window ratios of u_A and u_A/dt.
Check J_S/u_A and (-J_R)/u_A where frozen derivatives exist.
gates: All selected frozen baselines have the same qbot and READY response.
J_S/u_A and -J_R/u_A are within 1e-4 relative of unity for B1/B2/B4.
u_A is not invariant across the three windows.
u_A/dt is not invariant across the three windows.
No storage-overlap conclusion is drawn from the numerical ratio to MODFLOW Sy alone.
interpretation_rules: Call u_A a finite-window storage sensitivity where MAP03/E4 establishes dS/dH equivalence.
Do not call u_A a universal static specific yield.
Do not infer double counting merely because both SWAP and MODFLOW expose storage-like coefficients.
A double-counting claim requires a declared common physical volume/state and an equation-level ownership audit.
Window dependence is expected for transient propagation of a terminal-head perturbation through an unsaturated column.
forbidden: no calibration or new E4 runs
do not compare u_A and Sy as if they were automatically the same constitutive property
do not infer equilibrium storage from these short windows

governance.note: B1/B2/B4 summary values were inspected before this design was written. Treat MAP10 as transparent retrospective synthesis of frozen evidence, not preregistered validation.
